product.title: Great Ocean Road Full-Day Sunset Eco Tour from Melbourne

description.text: In Melbourne, this later-start Great Ocean Road eco day is timed for sunset at the Twelve Apostles, with Anglesea, the Memorial Arch, Lorne, Kennett River, and Loch Ard Gorge on the published circuit. The public page lists a 9am-to-11am hotel pickup window rather than the early-morning Go West eco departure. The format suits visitors who want dusk light on the limestone stacks without a reverse-itinerary luxury bus. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Melbourne, and the itinerary stays on those Surf Coast and Port Campbell stops that define this outing rather than a Halls Gap hiking day.

highlights: Loch Ard Gorge on the Shipwreck Coast

start.description: Pickup is only available from the list of hotels provided upon checkout. Pickup is between 9am-10am (AEST) and 10am-11am (AEDT) depending on which hotel you selected.

end.description: Return to the Melbourne meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
